test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language, 

‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the mother of Q’,

‘P - Q’ means ‘P is the wife of Q’,

‘P × Q’ means ‘P is the father of Q’ and

‘P ÷ Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’.

How is A related to E if ‘A + B - C × D ÷ E'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 P is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Wife
 Father
 Brother
 
 

 
 to Q
 
 

Given: A + B - C × D ÷ E

A + B → A is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/411f9799de24d74e7629ecb56034f2c06256dbf63e7d388233776aa10bad12c5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1e3b37ccedf490ea88e24ed64d47696b40d71cb9b3c409a1a9b432673799df6.png] 

B - C → B is the wife of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5cdd3614114dfaed96738df36f65e6110b6cb5a0d030d184d2696233ba76cdc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c79de8e0be959d2c044cb14b7572a5781aeb5c4f34035b0714a072798453abcf.png] 

C × D → C is the father of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cd62d1a48a86c9a432d77326739174feafbe1f4555eab621b0b90b764d6bd1b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/323edaa4f16f7af176fb90b9c128f35108bcb6f7f1c8e5813d72165a14fbdd14.png] 

D ÷ E → D is the brother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/547bf146d849e7ea0e81d841c560086d61f5793c9229baa6589cac1a1534fa50.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9ce368c8fc4bdb15693e4bf8e13c8428840069d3010d1150cd10e7770f20c21.png] 

Thus, A is E's mother's mother or maternal grandmother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
